headline: Japan October exports climb 20.5% on strong semiconductor demand
summary: Japanese exports rose 20.5% in October compared to the previous year, surpassing expectations of a 20.0% increase and narrowing the country's trade deficit behind robust semiconductor shipments.
why: Japan is a primary global provider of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, industrial machinery, and automotive components.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Export growth accelerated to 20.5%, beating consensus expectations.
